fidelityReview.notes: Full fixed historic-hotel exterior accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi scope, including Art Deco entrance, courtyard wings and classical crosswing; later eastern pool/service extension remains excluded. Started with the exact already-cleared Qualla2022FishynilaCC0 sidewalk original, individually inspected for entrance canopy, white soffit, supports, glazing and part of a beacon. Independent primary architectural writing fills the partial-photo coverage: Dyah Kusuma Wardhani’s2017site account describes Art Deco entrance, garden-facing colonnaded passages and a two-storey central suite between the wings; Maureen Nuradi’s2019architectural observations identify long shaded verandas and curved beams between columns on both garden wings; Richard/Roosandriantini’s2023field study records curved and pedimented gables, diminishing square entrance tower, white balustrades and roof ornaments. The municipal heritage record describes the raised central restaurant’s curved west/front portion, and the current operator confirms the courtyard-facing wrap-around balcony. These agree with the retained model’s defining features and native mapped compound/open gardens. Detailed roof pitches/joins/colour, precise opening spacing, balcony curvature, ornamental profiles, hidden elevations and minor current fixtures remain medium-fi estimates. No whole-building photographic survey claimed or required. Earlier private/attribution images are excluded.
